title: A Near-Optimal Lower Bound for $\ell_p$-Subspace Embeddings, $1\leq p<2$
summary: For $d \geq 2$, $p \geq 1$ and $ε> 0$, let $N_p(d,ε)$ be the smallest integer $N$ such that for every integer $n$ and every $A\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times d}$, there exists a matrix $Φ\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times n}$ satisfying $(1-ε)\lVert Ax\rVert_p\leq \lVertΦA x\rVert_p\leq (1+ε)\lVert Ax\rVert_p$ for all $x\in\mathbb{R}^d$. For every constant $p\geq 1$ with $p\not\in 2\mathbb{Z}$, when $d\gtrsim_p \log(1/ε)$, the bound \[ N_p(d,ε) \gtrsim_{p} \frac{d}{ε^2 \operatorname{polylog}(d/ε)} \] is established. This improves the previous lower bound $Ω(1/(ε^2\operatorname{polylog}(1/ε)))$ due to Li et al.…
